summary.problem: terminalBuffer enabled by default causes performance regressions and needs to be set back to false as the default setting.

summary.context: terminalBuffer remains available as an optional setting for users, but defaults to false until performance regressions are resolved.

steps: Update packages/core/src/config/config.ts to set default useTerminalBuffer to false in the Config constructor.

Update schemas/settings.schema.json to set default and markdownDescription default for terminalBuffer to false.
Update docs/cli/settings.md table entry for ui.terminalBuffer default value to false.
